questions.stem: A 40-year-old male presents with h/o easy fatigability, decreased interest in day-to-day activities, and dizziness. On examination he is pale and his weight is 50kgs. His Hb was found to be 7g/dl (normal 14-16g/dl), MCV -95fL, MCH -23pg/cell, serum iron 40μg/dl, serum ferritin 9ng/mL and peripheral smear shows microcytic hypochromic anemia. A diagnosis of iron deficiency anemia is made. Which of the following is true regarding iron replacement therapy in iron deficiency anemia?

options.label: A
options.text: Oral iron is to be given till the Hematocrit normalizes and should be discontinued afterward because of gastric side effects

options.label: B
options.text: Before giving parenteral iron dilute the dose and give it to check for anaphylaxis

options.label: C
options.text: 50% of the iron given is absorbed in 325 mg of ferrous sulfate tablets

options.label: D
options.text: Because of the adverse effects of oral iron always give parenteral iron for treatment

questions.answerText: Before giving parenteral iron dilute the dose and give it to check for anaphylaxis
questions.solutionHtml:
Before giving parenteral iron dilute the dose and give it to check for anaphylaxis

Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 650

questions.stem: A 5-year-old child comes to emergency swallowing 10 Tablets of iron formulations. The child had the following manifestations like vomiting, abdominal pain, haematemesis, diarrhea, lethargy Necrotizing gastroenteritis, shock, and metabolic acidosis. Which one of the following drugs would be useful in this condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Deferoxamine

questions.stem: Which of the following is incorrect about erythropoietin?

options.label: A
options.text: It is used for the treatment of anemia due to chronic renal failure

options.label: B
options.text: It results in a decrease in reticulocyte count

options.label: C
options.text: It decreases the requirement for blood transfusions

questions.answerText: It results in a decrease in reticulocyte count
questions.solutionHtml:
It results in a decrease in reticulocyte count

Filgrastim:

Use:

Filgrastim (G-CSF)
